objective: Audit the frozen English and Chinese Step5 boundaries by recomputing seller-connected components, detecting split leakage and review-assistance traces, and freezing a permanent exclusion manifest without modifying any upstream artifact.

review_assistance_patterns.pattern: \bgraph(?:ical)?\b|graph[ -]support|graph[ -]prun|retained by (?:the )?graph|not retained by (?:the )?graph|图谱|图结构|图支持|成图|图修剪

hard_rules: The Step5 inputs are read-only and are never rewritten.

Connected components are recomputed from seller_uid_left and seller_uid_right, not trusted from split_component_id; normalized seller aliases are additionally audited across splits and language pools.
All train, valid, and test pair, seller, normalized seller-alias, and recomputed component identifiers enter the permanent exclusion manifest.
All historically reviewed Step5 pairs and sellers are excluded from a future prospective holdout, including uncertain_holdout and audit_only rows.
A missing latest V8 readiness assignment is reported as archive_missing and is never represented as a successful check.
An existing output directory is never overwritten.
